brief:
The Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced planned power cuts across several areas of Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported. The cuts are scheduled for specific dates and times, beginning Tuesday, September 22, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. onward.

The company stated it regretted the necessity of the outages and provided a detailed schedule of affected neighborhoods and timeframes for the planned disconnections.
dek: The Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced planned power cuts across several areas of Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported.
title: Jerusalem electricity company announces power cuts in Ramallah district
